title: Jio True 5G Standalone (SA) Network Architecture & Spectrum
content: Jio operates India's only True 5G Standalone (SA) network, which has zero dependency on 4G legacy infrastructure. Unlike Non-Standalone (NSA) 5G used by some other operators which piggyback on existing 4G networks, Jio True 5G features a dedicated 5G core network, network slicing capabilities, ultra-low latency, and gigabit download speeds up to 1 Gbps+. Jio's True 5G utilizes a mix of sub-GHz (700 MHz - Band n28) for deep indoor and rural coverage, mid-band (3300 MHz - Band n78) for high capacity, and mmWave (26 GHz - Band n258) for ultra-high throughput in dense areas. Jio also features VoNR (Voice over New Radio) for crystal-clear voice calling natively on 5G without dropping to 4G.

title: Jio True 5G Welcome Offer & Eligibility
content: Under the Jio True 5G Welcome Offer, eligible Jio users get Unlimited 5G Data at speeds up to 1 Gbps+ at no additional cost. To be eligible for Unlimited 5G: (1) The user must have a 5G-compatible device with True 5G software enabled. (2) The user must be in a Jio True 5G coverage area (available nationwide in 7,000+ cities/towns). (3) The user must have an active prepaid plan with 2 GB/day or higher data (plans starting at ₹349 and above), or any active Jio Postpaid Plus plan. Users on plans offering 1.5 GB/day or less can activate Unlimited 5G by purchasing a True 5G Data Booster upgrade voucher (e.g., ₹51, ₹101, ₹151).

title: Jio True 5G Supported Devices & Activation Steps
content: Jio True 5G works on all major 5G smartphones in India. Supported brands include Apple (iPhone 12, 13, 14, 15, 16 series running iOS 16.2 or later), Samsung Galaxy (S series, Z Fold/Flip, A series 5G, M series 5G), Google Pixel (Pixel 6, 7, 8, 9 series), OnePlus (8T, 9, 10, 11, 12, Nord series), Xiaomi, Vivo, Oppo, Realme, Motorola, and Nothing. To enable True 5G: (1) On iPhone: Go to Settings > Cellular > Cellular Data Options > Voice & Data > Select '5G Auto' or '5G On' and toggle '5G Standalone' on. (2) On Android: Go to Settings > Mobile Network / SIM Card > Preferred Network Type > Select '5G / 4G / 3G / 2G (Auto)' and ensure 'Standalone 5G' is enabled if available. (3) Open MyJio app and tap on the 'True 5G' banner to check device compatibility and claim the Welcome Offer.

title: Difference Between JioFiber and JioAirFiber
content:
Key Differences Between JioFiber and JioAirFiber: 
1. Technology: JioFiber uses physical optical fiber cables (FTTH) routed directly into your home. JioAirFiber uses wireless 5G Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) capturing over-the-air True 5G signals via an outdoor antenna.
2. Availability: JioFiber is best suited for densely cabled apartment complexes and cities. JioAirFiber is designed for areas where physical fiber laying is difficult, including individual houses, independent villas, suburbs, and rural towns.
3. Latency & Consistency: JioFiber offers ultra-low wireline ping (3-5 ms), ideal for competitive online gaming. JioAirFiber offers low latency (15-25 ms) suitable for 4K streaming, video calls, and everyday browsing.
4. Upload/Download: JioFiber provides 100% symmetrical speeds (same upload and download). JioAirFiber provides high download speeds with asynchronous upload.
5. Both services include the same free 4K Smart Set-Top Box, 800+ live TV channels, and bundled OTT subscriptions (Netflix, Prime Video, Hotstar).

title: Jio eSIM Activation & Transfer Process for iPhone and Android
content:
How to Convert Physical SIM to Jio eSIM or Transfer to a New Device: 
Step 1: Obtain your device's 32-digit EID and 15-digit IMEI. (Dial *#06# on phone or go to Settings > About Phone).
Step 2: From your existing Jio number, send an SMS: 
`GETESIM <32-digit EID> <15-digit IMEI>` to 199.
Step 3: You will receive an SMS containing a 19-digit virtual eSIM number. Send confirmation SMS within 2 hours: 
`1` to 199.
Step 4: You will receive an automated consent call from Jio on 199. Press '1' to confirm the eSIM profile request.
Step 5: Install the eSIM profile on your phone: 
- On iPhone: Settings > Cellular > Tap 'Set Up Cellular' or tap notification 'Jio Data Plan is Ready to be Installed' > Continue.
- On Samsung/Pixel: Settings > Connections > SIM Manager > Add eSIM > Scan QR code received in email or tap 'Download profile'.
Activation Timeline: eSIM activates within 2 hours. Per regulatory guidelines, SMS services (incoming & outgoing) remain restricted for 24 hours post-activation.

title: How to Port to Jio (MNP - Mobile Number Portability)
content:
Step-by-step process to port your existing number from Airtel, Vi, or BSNL to Jio without changing your phone number: 
1. Generate UPC (Unique Porting Code): From your current SIM, send an SMS: 
`PORT <10-digit mobile number>` to 1900. (e.g. PORT 9876543210 to 1900).
2. Receive UPC: You will receive an SMS with an 8-character UPC code (valid for 4 days).
3. Book Free SIM Home Delivery on jio.com/port or visit any Jio Store / Reliance Digital retail outlet.
4. Document Verification: Keep your original Aadhaar card or government identity proof handy. Jio agent verifies via biometric e-KYC.
5. Porting Timeline: Under TRAI regulations, MNP takes 3 to 5 working days (inter-circle ports take up to 5 days). Your old SIM continues working until the exact porting time, resulting in zero downtime (typically at midnight).

title: Jio APN Internet Settings & Network Configuration
content:
Official Jio APN (Access Point Name) Settings for 4G & True 5G:
If your mobile data is not functioning, configure your APN manually: 
- Name: Jio (or Jio 4G)
- APN: jionet (all lowercase, no spaces)
- Proxy: Not Set
- Port: Not Set
- Username: Not Set
- Password: Not Set
- Server: Not Set
- MMSC: Not Set
- MMS Proxy / Port: Not Set
- MCC: 405 (default for India)
- MNC: 857, 861, 872 or auto-detected
- Authentication Type: None
- APN Type: default,supl,xcap
- APN Protocol: IPv4/IPv6
- APN Roaming Protocol: IPv4/IPv6
- Bearer: Unspecified (or LTE / 5G NR)
After saving, restart your phone or toggle Airplane Mode on and off.
